# Taskly (Python)

A small to-do API for teams.

```sh
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest
```

symbols.name: load_team
symbols.doc: Load a team by id. Raises TeamNotFound if it doesn't exist.

symbols.name: share_task
symbols.doc: Share a task with a teammate. Finished tasks can't be shared.

symbols.name: check_permissions
symbols.doc: Raise SharePermissionError unless ``user_id`` belongs to the task's team.

symbols.name: query
symbols.doc: Return every row of ``name`` whose fields equal all of ``where``.

symbols.name: slugify
symbols.doc: Turn a title into a URL-friendly slug: "Hello World" becomes "hello-world".
